name: @poe-code/agent-harness-tools-rust
description: Additive Rust live harness queue with self-contained Node bindings

scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-host.mjs && node ../mcp-protocol-rust/scripts/cargo.mjs build && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/prepare-host.mjs && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node ../mcp-protocol-rust/scripts/cargo.mjs test && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && tsc --project tsconfig.types.json && cd ../.. && vitest run --config packages/agent-harness-tools-rust/vitest.reference.config.mjs
